sloka: हम्स कारण्डव आकीर्णाः पद्मिनीः साधु पुष्पिताः ।इच्चेयम् सुखिनी द्रष्टुम् त्वया वीरेण सम्गता ॥२-२७-१७॥
transliteration: hamsa kāraṇḍava ākīrṇāḥ padminīḥ sādhu puṣpitāḥ ।icceyam sukhinī draṣṭum tvayā vīreṇa samgatā ॥2-27-17॥

translations.english: I wish to enjoy the lotus lakes in full bloom, abounding in swans and ducks in the company of a brave husband like you.
